extraction: Survey: Evaluation and Benchmarking of LLM Agents (arXiv:2507.21504). Two-dimensional taxonomy: (1) evaluation objectives - what to evaluate (agent behavior, capabilities, reliability, safety), (2) evaluation process - how to evaluate (interaction modes, datasets/benchmarks, metric computation, tooling). Enterprise challenges: role-based data access, reliability guarantees, dynamic long-horizon interactions, compliance. Future directions: holistic, realistic, scalable evaluation. Aims to bring clarity to fragmented agent evaluation landscape. Authors: Mohammadi, Li, Lo, Yip.
